english.note: Use this more general colloquial construction when describing the physical act of knocking the ball carrier down rather than naming the sports technique.

examples.english: When we saw the opponent carrying the ball, we rushed over and used a tackle to knock him down.
examples.traditional: 我哋見到對方帶波，就衝埋去將佢撲低咗。
